tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs on workfinds.app. Returns at most 50 jobs per search, in pages of 20 (pages 1 to 3), newest first unless sort is "relevance", each with a workfinds.app page URL, plus the total and a search_url that opens the same search on the site. Every argument is optional; combine them to narro

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job by its id or its workfinds.app job URL: title, company, location, work arrangement, employment type, the countries it accepts applicants from, salary when listed, when it was posted, whether it is still open, its apply URL on the employer site and its workfinds.app page. A closed job answers

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One employer by its id or page slug: name, number of open jobs, its workfinds.app page and, when known, its profile (industry, size, headquarters, founded, website, short description). Use search_jobs with company_id for its jobs.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: The country codes search_jobs accepts, with their English names.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: The role families search_jobs accepts as role.
